snapshot_note: Rules that The EMBO Journal and EMBO Reports guidelines state word for word. EMBO Press takes any format at first submission; most format rules apply to invited revisions and are marked so. SubmitReady reads the journal's own page on every run.

csl_style.note: EMBO Press reference guidelines apply at revision.

requirements.rule: Any format at first submission (one PDF or LaTeX file, or a DOCX with separate figures)
requirements.quote: You do not need to follow journal formatting guidelines for your initial submission.

requirements.rule: Title and abstract, and a title page with all authors and affiliations
requirements.quote: Provide a title and abstract, and ensure the title page includes all authors and affiliations.

requirements.rule: Cover letter on significance, related papers and any pre-discussion with an editor
requirements.quote: Authors should provide a cover letter describing the significance of their work, related or competing papers in press or under consideration elsewhere, and whether submission is in response to pre-discussion with an editor.

requirements.rule: Authorship, competing interests, dual publication and funding entered in eJP
requirements.quote: When submitting a manuscript via eJP, authors are required to provide information about the following topics: authorship, competing interests, dual publication, and funding sources.

requirements.rule: At revision: all journal formatting rules apply
requirements.quote: Manuscripts invited to resubmit must be formatted according to all journal guidelines.

requirements.rule: At revision: title of at most 100 characters, no abbreviations
requirements.quote: The total length of the title should not exceed 100 characters (including spaces).

requirements.rule: At revision: one-paragraph abstract of at most 175 words, no citations
requirements.quote: This should be a single paragraph not exceeding 175 words.
‘Data not shown’ is not permitted; all significant data should be displayed in the main figures or Expanded View information.

requirements.rule: At revision: structured methods with a Reagents and Tools Table
requirements.quote: All research articles (Article, Report, Method, Resource) submitted as revised versions must include a structured methods section that includes a Reagents and Tools Table followed by a Methods and Protocols section.

requirements.rule: Data availability section right after the Methods
requirements.quote: Datasets and computer code that were generated in the reported study should be listed in a structured manner in the “Data availability” section immediately after the Methods section.

The journal requires a statement specifying whether or not authors have competing interests – defined as all potential or actual interests that could be perceived to influence the presentation or interpretation of an article.

requirements.rule: Author contributions entered as CRediT roles in the submission system
Check the journal's own page for article types and limits, Expanded View rules and fees
